title: The accuracy of jobseekers’ wage expectations
title_zh: 求职者工资预期的准确性
title_primary: 求职者工资预期的准确性
title_secondary: The accuracy of jobseekers’ wage expectations
authors: Marco Caliendo, Robert Mahlstedt, Aiko Schmeißer, Sophie Wagner
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the accuracy of wage expectations among unemployed workers by comparing subjective beliefs to benchmark and realized wages using linked survey-administrative data. On average, jobseekers overestimate their reemployment wages, with optimism concentrated among those with low earnings potential. Beliefs are anchored to past wages, and inaccuracies persist over the course of unemployment and in response to stronger search incentives. Moreover, there is an asymmetry in belief formation: individuals who are likely to experience wage losses relative to their previous job are particularly rigid in adjusting their expectations. Finally, wage optimism predicts higher reservation wages, greater search intensity, and delayed reemployment.
abstract_zh: 我们利用关联的调查-行政数据，通过将主观信念与基准工资及实际实现工资进行比较，研究了失业工人对工资预期的准确性。平均而言，求职者高估了其再就业工资，这种乐观情绪主要集中在潜在收入较低的人群中。信念锚定于过去的工资水平，且这种不准确性在失业期间及面对更强的求职激励时持续存在。此外，信念形成存在不对称性：那些可能相对于先前工作经历工资下降的个体，在调整其预期时尤为僵化。最后，工资乐观情绪预示着更高的保留工资、更强的求职强度以及延迟的再就业。

title: Not Too Much, Not Too Little: A Goldilocks Approach to Sustainable, Universal Electricity Access in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 不多不少：撒哈拉以南非洲可持续普及电力接入的“金发姑娘”路径
title_primary: 不多不少：撒哈拉以南非洲可持续普及电力接入的“金发姑娘”路径
title_secondary: Not Too Much, Not Too Little: A Goldilocks Approach to Sustainable, Universal Electricity Access in Sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Díaz-Pastor, Santos J., Liu, Yang, Pérez-Arriaga, Ignacio J.
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper proposes a replicable regulatory and financial framework to achieve universal electricity access as a core component of a just energy transition in Sub-Saharan Africa. It argues that universal access is feasible under realistic constraints when electrification planning, tariff regulation, and capital mobilization are designed as one coherent system rather than separate workstreams. The analysis rests on a computational, multi-period financial model that integrates individual interacting sub-models for every actor in the distribution segment. Versions of the same overall approach are applied to three countries, spanning different starting points and sector structures. Uganda provides the reference implementation in the wake of an expiring private distribution concession; Zambia recalibrates the same logic to a distressed national utility and a thin domestic revenue base; and Madagascar—where the framework is already being applied—shows it moving from design to district-scale delivery in the lowest electricity access setting of the three. The central mechanism is an integrated national planning, regulatory, business, and financing architecture that coordinates grid extension, mini-grids, and stand-alone systems within a single distribution-level financial plan. The framework separates two gaps that are routinely mixed—the viability gap, the recurring shortfall between affordable tariff revenues and the regulated cost of service, and the financing needs, the timing mismatch between front-loaded investment and gradual cost recovery—and shows that they each call for a distinct instrument. The evidence indicates that universal access can be reached without permanent reliance on external grants, and that extending the access horizon rather than compressing investment improves feasibility while still reaching everyone—so that the design becomes a problem of finding an electrification target year, a pattern of overall subsidy, and tariffs that are just right, each neither too much nor too little. The paper reframes universal access as a challenge of cost allocation and institutional design, showing that affordability, inclusion, and financial sustainability are not competing objectives once electrification is designed as one system.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一套可复制的监管与金融框架，旨在将普遍电力接入作为撒哈拉以南非洲公正能源转型的核心组成部分。文章主张，在现实约束下，当电气化规划、电价监管与资本动员被设计为一个连贯体系而非各自独立的工作流程时，普遍接入是可行的。分析基于一个计算性的多期金融模型，该模型整合了配电环节中每个参与者的独立交互子模型。同一总体方法的多个版本被应用于三个国家，覆盖了不同的起点和行业结构。乌干达提供了在私营配电特许经营权到期后的参考实施案例；赞比亚将同样的逻辑重新校准应用于陷入困境的国家公用事业和薄弱的国内收入基础；而马达加斯加——该框架已在当地实施——展示了其从设计阶段推进到区域规模交付的过程，且该国的电力接入水平在三国中最低。核心机制是一个集成的国家规划、监管、商业和融资架构，在单一的配电层面财务计划中协调电网延伸、微型电网和独立系统。该框架区分了两种常被混淆的缺口——可行性缺口，即可负担电价收入与监管服务成本之间的经常性短缺，以及融资需求，即前期投资与逐步成本回收之间的时间错配——并表明它们各自需要不同的工具。证据表明，无需永久依赖外部赠款即可实现普遍接入，且延长接入时间跨度而非压缩投资可提高可行性，同时仍能覆盖所有人——因此设计问题转化为寻找一个恰到好处的电气化目标年份、整体补贴模式及电价，每一项既不过多也不过少。本文将普遍接入重新定义为成本分配与制度设计的挑战，表明一旦电气化被设计为一个整体系统，可负担性、包容性和财务可持续性便不再是相互竞争的目标。

title: Export Controls and Innovation in Sanctioned Countries
title_zh: 出口管制与被制裁国家的创新
title_primary: 出口管制与被制裁国家的创新
title_secondary: Export Controls and Innovation in Sanctioned Countries
authors: Xueyue Liu, Yu Liu, Alexey Makarin, Jaya Wen
official: 官方在线 2025-09-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how Chinese firms responded to the 2007 U.S. "China Military Catch-All Rule,'' which restricted exports of dual-use products with military applications. By comparing sanctioned goods to those that were just excluded from the policy, we estimate firm-level effects on imports, R&D, and patenting. Treated firms sharply reduced imports of controlled products and increased innovation activity: R&D spending rose by 49.1%, patenting by 41.3%, and the number of active inventors by 30.4%. Patenting in related technologies increased by 65.1% and patents on other topics increased by 41.6%, indicating a broad innovation response rather than one narrowly focused on replacing restricted inputs. We also examine domestic suppliers of controlled goods and find that their innovation increased, but was concentrated in patent applications related to the restricted products, which more than quadrupled. Taken together, these results suggest that a key unintended consequence of export controls is their potential to accelerate innovation in the sanctioned economy.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2007年美国“中国军事全面管制规则”对中国企业的影响，该规则限制了具有军事应用的双用途产品的出口。通过将受制裁商品与恰好被排除在政策之外的商品进行比较，我们估计了企业在进口、研发和专利申请方面的效应。受制裁企业大幅减少了受控产品的进口，并增加了创新活动：研发支出增长了49.1%，专利申请量增长了41.3%，活跃发明人数量增长了30.4%。相关技术的专利申请量增长了65.1%，其他主题的专利增长了41.6%，这表明创新响应是广泛的，而非仅仅集中于替代受限制的投入品。我们还考察了受控商品的国内供应商，发现其创新有所增加，但主要集中在与受限制产品相关的专利申请上，这些申请数量增长了四倍以上。综合来看，这些结果表明，出口管制的一个关键意外后果是可能加速受制裁经济体的创新。

title: Regulated Prices, Global Capacity, and Drug Shortages
title_zh: 管制价格、全球产能与药品短缺
title_primary: 管制价格、全球产能与药品短缺
title_secondary: Regulated Prices, Global Capacity, and Drug Shortages
authors: Pierre Dubois, Gosia Majewska, Valentina Reig
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Drug shortages affect most pharmaceutical markets. We develop a model of capacity choice for a firm supplying multiple countries under regulated prices, in which supply shocks generate shortages: the highest-price countries remain fully served, middle-price countries are rationed, and the lowest-price countries are excluded, so that domestic and foreign prices affect both the frequency and the magnitude of shortages. We then develop a method to detect shortages and measure their magnitude using only national sales data. Applying it to monthly pharmacy sales in France over 2019-2024, we find an average shortage probability of 26%. Higher French prices reduce both the probability and the magnitude of shortages in France. Higher UK prices reduce the probability of French shortages but increase their magnitude, while higher Polish prices reduce both, consistent with the capacity and allocation channels of the model. Counterfactuals on antipsychotics show that targeted price increases can substantially reduce shortages at limited expenditure cost.
abstract_zh: 药品短缺影响着大多数药品市场。我们构建了一个模型，研究在管制价格下，供应多个国家的企业在产能选择上的决策，其中供应冲击会导致短缺：价格最高的国家保持完全供应，价格中等的国家实行配给，而价格最低的国家则被排除在外，因此国内和国外价格同时影响短缺的频率和严重程度。随后，我们开发了一种仅利用国家销售数据来检测短缺并衡量其严重程度的方法。将该方法应用于2019-2024年法国月度药房销售数据，我们发现平均短缺概率为26%。法国价格的提高既降低了法国短缺的概率，也减轻了其严重程度。英国价格的提高降低了法国短缺的概率，但增加了其严重程度，而波兰价格的提高则同时降低了这两者，这与模型中的产能和分配渠道相一致。针对抗精神病药物的反事实分析表明，有针对性的价格上调可以在有限支出成本下大幅减少短缺。

title: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
title_zh: 在展开中识别关键节点：来自120年报道的基础、测量与应用
title_primary: 在展开中识别关键节点：来自120年报道的基础、测量与应用
title_secondary: Detecting Critical Junctures as They Unfold: Foundations, Measurement, and Applications from 120 Years of Reporting
authors: Michael Callen, Gregory Levy, Saipremnath Muthukumaran, Jonathan L. Weigel, Noam Yuchtman
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how — and when — institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive — 11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019 — while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s — a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
abstract_zh: 解释为何一些国家走向富裕而另一些国家却陷入贫困，关键在于理解制度如何变迁以及何时变迁。大量研究指出，制度变迁往往发生在“关键节点”——即多种制度未来路径并存，包括回归原状的可能性的时刻。然而，多数实证研究仅从事后视角审视关键节点，这可能导致遗漏那些制度处于变动之中但最终未发生根本改变的 pivotal 时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，用以在关键节点展开之际即时识别它们。我们的核心洞见在于，将关键节点理解为关于制度的不确定性时期，这为文本分类器提供了一个具有理论依据的检测对象，使其能在同期话语中捕捉此类信号。在本章中，我们运用这一理念，借助报纸文本作为关于当时制度不确定性信念的丰富信息来源，研究历史关键节点。我们将此洞见转化为测量策略，训练了一个基于大型语言模型的分类器，并将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案——涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章——同时将主要实证分析聚焦于1900年至2019年的120年报道。这产生了首个基于关键节点概念、长期且以文本为基础的制度不确定性度量。与现有的地缘政治和经济风险指数相比，我们的度量在多个方面实现了创新：（i）它能在没有正式制度变迁的时期捕捉到高度不确定性，符合关键节点的前向定义；（ii）它为重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）提供了更早的信号；（iii）它使用统一的前向度量评估候选关键节点；（iv）它为研究关键节点如何塑造制度及长期发展开辟了新途径。当前，基于《泰晤士报》的指数显示，美国和英国的制度不确定性水平与20世纪40年代初相当——这一信号是其他主流风险指标所遗漏的。

title: Monetary and Macroprudential Policy and Welfare in an Estimated Four‐Agent New Keynesian Model
title_zh: 估计四主体新凯恩斯模型中的货币与宏观审慎政策及福利
title_primary: 估计四主体新凯恩斯模型中的货币与宏观审慎政策及福利
title_secondary: Monetary and Macroprudential Policy and Welfare in an Estimated Four‐Agent New Keynesian Model
authors: GEORGE J. BRATSIOTIS, KASUN D. PATHIRAGE
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the social and agent‐specific welfare effects of monetary and macroprudential policy in a four‐agent estimated macro‐economic model comprising “ banked simple households ,” “ underbanked simple households ,” “ firm owners ,” and “ bank owners .” Optimal capital requirement and loan loss provisions ratios improve all agent‐specific and social welfare, but imply smaller gains for simple households and firm owners that rely on credit. Countercyclical capital buffers support firm owners and bank owners with smaller gains for the two simple households, while countercyclical loan loss provisions improve social welfare only for specific shocks. Coordination between monetary and macroprudential policies yields higher social welfare than no coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了货币政策和宏观审慎政策在包含“银行化简单家庭”、“非银行化简单家庭”、“企业主”和“银行所有者”四类主体的估计宏观经济模型中的社会及主体特定福利效应。最优资本充足率和贷款损失准备金比率能够改善所有主体特定福利及社会福利，但对依赖信贷的简单家庭和企业主而言，其福利改善幅度较小。逆周期资本缓冲有利于企业主和银行所有者，但对两类简单家庭的福利改善较小；而逆周期贷款损失准备金仅在特定冲击下才能提升社会福利。货币政策与宏观审慎政策之间的协调比不协调能带来更高的社会福利。

title: High School Effects on Civic Engagement
title_zh: 高中教育对公民参与的影响
title_primary: 高中教育对公民参与的影响
title_secondary: High School Effects on Civic Engagement
authors: Mumma, Kirsten Slungaard
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Preparing young people for citizenship is a foundational purpose of public education, yet little is known about whether or how K-12 schools impact civic engagement. Using education, birth, and voting records for nine cohorts of students in Indiana, I estimate and assess the validity of high school e!ects on voting. School e!ects on voting are significant and practically meaningful: a one standard deviation increase in school civic e!ects increases the probability of voting by 2.1 percentage points (5.3 percent) and also predicts increases in voter registration and times voting. School civic e!ects are positively associated with peer parental civic norms.
abstract_zh: 培养年轻人的公民意识是公共教育的基本目标，但关于K-12学校是否以及如何影响公民参与的研究仍十分有限。本研究利用印第安纳州九届学生的教育、出生及投票记录数据，对高中教育对投票行为的影响效应进行估计与效度评估。研究发现，学校对投票行为的影响具有显著的实际意义：学校公民教育效应每提升一个标准差，学生投票概率将提高2.1个百分点（增幅达5.3%），同时选民登记率与投票次数也呈现增长趋势。学校公民教育效应与同伴家长的公民规范呈正相关关系。

title: The Electoral Impact of Housing Climate Policy: Evidence from Germany
title_zh: 住房气候政策的选举影响：来自德国的证据
title_primary: 住房气候政策的选举影响：来自德国的证据
title_secondary: The Electoral Impact of Housing Climate Policy: Evidence from Germany
authors: Dorothea Kistinger, Noah Kögel, Nicolas Koch, Matthias Kalkuhl
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The transition to carbon-neutral residential heating poses extraordinary policy challenges to societies in Europe and beyond. In this paper, we study the electoral consequences of an amendment to the German Building Energy Act (GEG) aimed at phasing-out fossil-based heating systems. We use granular building stock data to approximate heterogeneity in household compliance costs and apply difference-in-differences and triple difference models to estimate its impacts on vote shares at the municipal level. For the state elections in Bavaria and Hesse, we find relative gains for the far-right (+2.4 pp) and conservative opposition parties (+6.5 pp) and losses for the incumbent federal government parties (−2.9 pp) in the baseline specification of our model. For the latter two, the effects are more pronounced in rural municipalities. These findings highlight the importance of holistic climate policy approaches that account for salient and heterogeneous costs to mitigate political backlash.
abstract_zh: 向碳中和住宅供暖的转型对欧洲及其他地区的社会构成了特殊的政策挑战。本文研究了德国《建筑能源法》（GEG）修正案（旨在逐步淘汰化石燃料供暖系统）的选举后果。我们利用精细的建筑存量数据来近似衡量家庭合规成本的异质性，并采用双重差分和三重差分模型，估算该修正案在市级层面对政党得票率的影响。在巴伐利亚和黑森州的州选举中，我们的基准模型结果显示，极右翼政党得票率相对上升2.4个百分点，保守派反对党得票率上升6.5个百分点，而联邦执政党得票率下降2.9个百分点。对于后两者而言，这种效应在农村地区更为显著。这些发现凸显了采取整体性气候政策方法的重要性，该方法需考虑显著且异质性的成本，以减轻政治反弹。

title: Catastrophic Wildfires & Suicide
title_zh: 灾难性野火与自杀
title_primary: 灾难性野火与自杀
title_secondary: Catastrophic Wildfires & Suicide
authors: Chandler Hubbard, Nino Abashidze, Hannah Hennighausen, Alexander James
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We estimate the impact of catastrophic wildfires on suicide. Leveraging an eight-year panel of county-by-month restricted-use mortality data for California, we find that catastrophic wildfires that destroy at least 2% of a county’s housing stock cause a 47% increase in the suicide rate (roughly nine excess suicides) in the six-month aftermath of an event. Exploring sources of heterogeneity, effects are largely driven by men. Mechanisms are explored and suggest that suicide results from the loss of property and direct loss of life, rather than smoke exposure. These findings suggest that wildfires may be deadlier and more expensive than previously thought.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文估算了灾难性野火对自杀率的影响。利用加州按县-月划分的八年限制使用死亡率面板数据，我们发现，摧毁一个县至少2%住房存量的灾难性野火，会在事件发生后的六个月内导致自杀率上升47%（约增加9例自杀）。在异质性来源的探索中，影响主要由男性群体驱动。机制分析表明，自杀源于财产损失和直接生命损失，而非烟雾暴露。这些发现表明，野火可能比此前认为的更具致命性和更高成本。

title: 住房拆迁“房票”安置的福利效应与最优补贴
title_zh: 住房拆迁“房票”安置的福利效应与最优补贴
title_primary: 住房拆迁“房票”安置的福利效应与最优补贴
authors: 王慧, 徐舒
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: “房票”安置作为地方政府探索的创新性拆迁补偿模式,近年来应用范围持续扩大。本文基于罗伊选择模型和微观数据,系统分析了“房票”安置模式在存量住房去库存和优化财政支出方面的作用,并探讨了“房票”安置中最优补贴率的确定及其福利效应。研究表明,“房票”安置平均带来了28 199元的家庭福利改进,等价于样本家庭年平均收入的37.38%;同时,“房票”政策通过引导拆迁居民购房选择,使存量住房库存下降,节约了政府的拆迁建设成本。测算结果显示,当前补贴率下公共资金边际绩效在0.99~4.58范围内,表明房票安置补贴有显著的社会净收益。最后,本文对最优“房票”补贴率的分析显示,在综合考虑拆迁家庭福利改进和财政补贴成本的情况下,“房票”补贴率还有进一步提升空间。

title: Did Drug Decriminalization Increase Overdoses
title_zh: 毒品非刑事化是否增加了药物过量
title_primary: 毒品非刑事化是否增加了药物过量
title_secondary: Did Drug Decriminalization Increase Overdoses
authors: David Hall, Benjamin Hansen, Kyutaro Matsuzawa
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the effect of drug decriminalization on overdose mortality using Oregon's Measure 110 and Washington's Blake decision. Synthetic-control estimates show that both decriminalization regimes sharply reduced drug arrests and were followed by sustained increases in overdose mortality relative to matched counterfactuals. The estimates imply approximately 1,186 excess deaths in Oregon and 1,895 in Washington from 2021 through 2023. We also revisit the role of fentanyl supply shocks. A fentanyl-share control may partly capture enforcement-driven declines in non-fentanyl NFLIS reports, while alternative fentanyl measures leave positive overdose effects.
abstract_zh: 我们利用俄勒冈州的110号法案和华盛顿州的布莱克判决，研究毒品非刑事化对过量致死率的影响。合成控制法估计显示，两种非刑事化制度均大幅减少了毒品逮捕，但与匹配的反事实相比，随后出现了过量致死率的持续上升。这些估计表明，从2021年到2023年，俄勒冈州约有1186例超额死亡，华盛顿州约有1895例。我们还重新审视了芬太尼供应冲击的作用。芬太尼份额控制可能部分捕捉到执法驱动的非芬太尼NFLIS报告减少，而替代性芬太尼指标则留下了正向的过量致死效应。

title: High-quality innovation, supply-chain spillovers, and firm-level employment
title_zh: 高质量创新、供应链溢出与企业层面就业
title_primary: 高质量创新、供应链溢出与企业层面就业
title_secondary: High-quality innovation, supply-chain spillovers, and firm-level employment
authors: Siyu Cao, Zhen Yang, Tingting Wu, Wenlong Liu, Jiapeng An
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using the full text of invention patents filed by Chinese listed firms, we construct a firm-level innovation-quality index by pre-training and fine-tuning a deep learning language model, and link this measure to National Tax Survey records and disclosed supplier – customer dyads. From a value-chain coordination perspective, we examine bilateral labour-demand spillovers associated with focal firms’ innovation-quality upgrading. The results show that innovation-quality upgrading at focal firms significantly increases labour demand among upstream and downstream suppliers. A one-standard-deviation increase in innovation quality raises upstream and downstream employment by 0.84% and 0.77%, respectively. This study also employs a shift-share instrumental variable (SSIV) design to address potential endogeneity. Mechanism analyses identify two channels: an output-demand channel, whereby innovation quality raises productivity, profitability, and product quality, expanding input demand and downstream market demand; and a trade-credit channel, whereby improved innovation credentials strengthen reputation and balance-sheet capacity, enabling trade credit and guarantees that relax partners’ financing constraints and stimulate hiring. This study provides managers and policymakers with insights into how high-quality innovation stabilizes employment.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国上市公司发明专利申请全文，通过预训练与微调深度学习语言模型构建企业层面创新质量指数，并将该指标与全国税收调查记录及公开的供应商-客户配对数据进行关联。从价值链协调视角出发，我们考察了焦点企业创新质量提升对双边劳动力需求的溢出效应。研究发现，焦点企业创新质量升级显著增加了上下游供应商的劳动力需求：创新质量每提高一个标准差，上游和下游就业分别增长0.84%和0.77%。本研究还采用份额转移工具变量（SSIV）设计以应对潜在内生性问题。机制分析识别出两条传导路径：一是产出需求渠道——创新质量通过提升生产率、盈利能力和产品质量，扩大投入需求与下游市场需求；二是贸易信贷渠道——创新资质的改善增强了企业声誉与资产负债表能力，使其能够提供贸易信贷与担保，从而缓解合作伙伴的融资约束并刺激雇佣行为。本研究为管理者与政策制定者提供了高质量创新如何稳定就业的实践启示。

title: Relationship banking: The borrower’s incentives channel
title_zh: 关系型银行：借款人的激励渠道
title_primary: 关系型银行：借款人的激励渠道
title_secondary: Relationship banking: The borrower’s incentives channel
authors: Pejman Abedifar, Soroush Kamyab, Steven Ongena, Amine Tarazi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: What is the impact of a prior banking relationship on a borrower’s incentives to avoid default? To answer this question, we exploit a unique institutional setting and data on 149,230 mortgage loans tracked for twenty four months. We find that the presence of a relationship diminishes borrower’s default risk by approximately 4%, attributable exclusively to the value of the relationship for the borrower. This effect persists during the notable surge in loan defaults during COVID-19 and is even more pronounced for borrowers affected by a natural disaster, as well as among wealthier and married male borrowers.
abstract_zh: 既有银行关系对借款人避免违约的激励有何影响？为解答此问题，我们利用独特的制度环境及追踪二十四个月的149,230笔抵押贷款数据。研究发现，关系的存在使借款人的违约风险降低约4%，这一效应完全归因于关系对借款人的价值。该效应在COVID-19期间贷款违约显著激增时依然持续，并且对于受自然灾害影响的借款人，以及较富裕和已婚男性借款人中更为显著。

title: Efficient taxation of labour income under the threat of conflict
title_zh: 冲突威胁下的劳动收入有效课税
title_primary: 冲突威胁下的劳动收入有效课税
title_secondary: Efficient taxation of labour income under the threat of conflict
authors: Asen Ivanov
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: I take a simple model of linear taxation of labour income and append to it the possibility that the chosen tax schedule triggers conflict in society. I demonstrate theoretically that, under certain assumptions, the resulting set of efficient tax schedules is a proper subset of the set of efficient tax schedules in a standard model without the possibility of conflict. Then, I show in a numerical example that the former set can be much smaller than the latter.
abstract_zh: 我采用一个简单的劳动收入线性税收模型，并加入所选税收方案可能引发社会冲突的可能性。理论上证明，在特定假设下，由此产生的有效税收方案集合是标准模型中无冲突可能性下有效税收方案集合的一个真子集。随后，通过数值示例展示，前者集合可能远小于后者。

title: Too complex to collaborate? Rethinking CSO–municipal relations for public service provision
title_zh: 过于复杂而难以合作？重新思考公共服务供给中的公民社会组织与市政关系
title_primary: 过于复杂而难以合作？重新思考公共服务供给中的公民社会组织与市政关系
title_secondary: Too complex to collaborate? Rethinking CSO–municipal relations for public service provision
authors: Renzo de la Riva Agüero
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Collaboration between civil society organizations (CSOs) and municipalities is often seen as beneficial for service delivery, especially in under-resourced cities where local governments face capacity and operational constraints. However, it remains unclear how these partnerships influence performance across services of differing complexity. Drawing on qualitative fieldwork in Peruvian municipalities, this article examines how collaboration with community-based CSOs affects outcomes in simple versus complex services, using waste management as a comparative case. The analysis focuses on three proximate relational mechanisms: municipal collaboration management capacity, local officials’ perceptions of CSOs, and CSO leadership engagement. The findings show that these factors interact to shape service performance, with their impact conditioned by service complexity. While collaboration can succeed under suboptimal conditions in simple services, complex services perform well where the three elements are jointly strong and aligned. The study highlights the need to strengthen collaboration management, challenge municipal biases, and support CSO leadership—particularly in settings facing complex service challenges.
abstract_zh: 民间社会组织（CSOs）与地方政府之间的合作通常被视为有助于提升公共服务供给，尤其是在资源匮乏、地方政府面临能力与运作约束的城市中。然而，这些合作关系如何影响不同复杂度服务的绩效，仍不明确。基于在秘鲁多个城市开展的定性田野调查，本文以垃圾管理为比较案例，考察与社区型民间社会组织合作对简单服务与复杂服务结果的影响差异。分析聚焦于三个邻近的关系性机制：市政合作管理能力、地方官员对民间社会组织的认知，以及民间社会组织领导层的参与度。研究发现，这些因素相互作用，共同塑造服务绩效，而其影响受服务复杂度的调节。在简单服务中，即便合作条件并非最优，合作仍可取得成功；而在复杂服务中，只有当三个要素同时强劲且相互契合时，服务绩效才表现良好。本研究强调，有必要加强合作管理、纠正市政层面的偏见，并支持民间社会组织领导力建设——尤其是在面临复杂服务挑战的情境中。

title: A User's Guide to Reducing the Federal Reserve's Balance Sheet
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: A User's Guide to Reducing the Federal Reserve's Balance Sheet
authors: Alyssa G. Anderson, Alessandro Barbarino, Anthony M. Diercks, Stephen Miran
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: For the avoidance of doubt: 1) This catalog presents and analyzes a variety of options for reducing the Federal Reserve's balance sheet. Nothing here is an endorsement of any specific policy option; this is a menu of options. Combined, we estimate these options open the door to balance sheet reduction of $1.2 to $2.1 trillion within the Fed's current ample reserves framework. While we do not advocate for or against a return to a scarce reserves regime, further reductions would be possible with a return to scarce reserves. 2) The process of materially shrinking the balance sheet would require a great deal of implementation and rulemaking work in advance and would take time, at least a year and quite possibly several, before the Fed can begin shrinking its balance sheet. If undertaken, there are good reasons for moving slowly and gingerly, and to take steps to ensure financial markets are able to absorb the reissue of securities that roll off the Federal Reserve's balance sheet.
abstract_zh: 为免疑义：1）本目录介绍并分析了缩减美联储资产负债表的多种方案。此处不构成对任何特定政策选项的背书，仅作为选项清单。综合估算，这些选项为美联储在当前充足准备金框架下缩减1.2至2.1万亿美元资产负债表规模提供了可能。虽然我们既不主张也不反对回归稀缺准备金制度，但若回归该制度，则可实现进一步缩减。2）实质性缩表过程需要提前开展大量实施与规则制定工作，且需耗时至少一年甚至数年，美联储方能启动缩表。若付诸实施，有充分理由采取审慎渐进的方式，并采取措施确保金融市场能够吸收美联储资产负债表到期证券的再发行。

title: Flattening governments, flattening growth: Equalization–efficiency trade-off in jurisdictional reform
title_zh: 扁平化政府与扁平化增长：辖区改革中的均等化-效率权衡
title_primary: 扁平化政府与扁平化增长：辖区改革中的均等化-效率权衡
title_secondary: Flattening governments, flattening growth: Equalization–efficiency trade-off in jurisdictional reform
authors: Shawn Xiaoguang Chen, Pei Li, Saijie Sun
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Flattening government hierarchies not only reduces organizational layers but also restructures fiscal capacity, reshaping both local growth incentives and regional redistribution. This paper identifies a fundamental trade-off: while flattening promotes equalization across regions, it simultaneously undermines economic efficiency at the local level. We develop a multi-tier government model showing that reallocating fiscal authority upward enlarges common revenue pools, which enhance redistribution but dilute local governments’ incentives to foster growth. Empirically, we exploit China’s staggered Province-Managing-County (PMC) reform as a quasi-natural experiment and apply a stacked difference-in-differences strategy to county-level panel data from 2000 to 2007. We find that the PMC reform significantly reduced intra-provincial inequality—measured by Gini, Theil, and related indices—but concurrently lowered county GDP per capita. Reductions in physical investment and firm-level productivity, rather than shifts in labor input, drove the efficiency loss. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that provinces with stronger fiscal pooling (higher VAT-sharing ratios) and broader administrative spans experienced a more severe equalization–efficiency trade-off. Our findings extend fiscal federalism and organizational structure theories by showing how hierarchy flattening and fiscal pooling jointly shape the balance between redistribution and local economic performance.
abstract_zh: 扁平化政府层级不仅减少了组织层级，还重构了财政能力，从而重塑了地方增长激励与区域再分配格局。本文揭示了一个根本性的权衡：扁平化在促进区域间均等化的同时，也削弱了地方层面的经济效率。我们构建了一个多层政府模型，表明将财政权力向上重新配置会扩大共同收入池，这增强了再分配效应，但稀释了地方政府促进增长的激励。在实证方面，我们利用中国分阶段推行的“省直管县”（PMC）改革作为准自然实验，并采用堆叠双重差分策略分析2000至2007年的县级面板数据。研究发现，PMC改革显著降低了省内不平等——以基尼系数、泰尔指数及相关指标衡量——但同时降低了县级人均GDP。效率损失主要源于物质投资和企业层面生产率的下降，而非劳动力投入的变化。异质性分析表明，财政统筹程度更强（增值税分享比例更高）和行政管辖范围更广的省份，其均等化—效率权衡更为严峻。我们的研究拓展了财政联邦主义和组织结构理论，揭示了层级扁平化与财政统筹如何共同塑造再分配与地方经济绩效之间的平衡。

title: Government debt management and inflation with real and nominal bonds
title_zh: 实际与名义债券下的政府债务管理与通胀
title_primary: 实际与名义债券下的政府债务管理与通胀
title_secondary: Government debt management and inflation with real and nominal bonds
authors: Lukas Schmid, Vytautas Valaitis, Alessandro T. Villa
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can governments use real bonds such as Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) to tame inflation? We propose a novel framework of optimal debt management with sticky prices and a government issuing nominal and real state-uncontingent bonds. A government debt portfolio with both nominal and real bonds helps completing markets unless the monetary policy stance renders them perfect substitutes. Under Full Commitment, the government borrows with nominal debt and accumulates real assets, to be able to use inflation to smooth taxes. With No Commitment, the government portfolio favors real bonds to strategically prevent future governments from monetizing debt ex-post. Quantitatively, our model with No Commitment is consistent with the small and persistent TIPS share in U.S. data. A higher TIPS share mitigates the commitment friction, and effectively curbs inflation.
abstract_zh: 政府能否利用实际债券（如通货膨胀保值国债，TIPS）来抑制通胀？我们提出一个新颖的最优债务管理框架，其中包含价格粘性，且政府发行名义和实际的无状态或有债券。包含名义与实际债券的政府债务组合有助于完善市场，除非货币政策立场使它们成为完全替代品。在完全承诺下，政府通过名义债务借款并积累实际资产，以便利用通胀来平滑税收。在无承诺情况下，政府组合倾向于实际债券，以策略性地防止未来政府事后将债务货币化。定量分析显示，我们的无承诺模型与美国数据中小而持久的TIPS份额相符。更高的TIPS份额缓解了承诺摩擦，并有效遏制了通胀。

title: Corporate governance in microfinance institutions: A systematic review of theoretical perspectives, methodological approaches, and empirical evidence
title_zh: 小额信贷机构的公司治理：理论视角、方法论与实证证据的系统综述
title_primary: 小额信贷机构的公司治理：理论视角、方法论与实证证据的系统综述
title_secondary: Corporate governance in microfinance institutions: A systematic review of theoretical perspectives, methodological approaches, and empirical evidence
authors: Giovanni Cardillo, Alessandra Cavallo, Giuseppe Torluccio
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Corporate governance in microfinance institutions (MFIs) significantly influences their ability to pursue financial sustainability and social outreach, yet two decades of empirical research have produced fragmented and contradictory findings. This paper presents a systematic review of 47 peer-reviewed studies published between 2005 and 2025 that examine how governance mechanisms shape MFI dual performance. Rather than treating theoretical concentration and empirical inconsistency as symptoms of weak scholarship, we demonstrate that both reflect structural constraints embedded in prevailing data infrastructures. Widely used datasets, most prominently MIX Market, disproportionately support agency-theoretic constructs while rendering relational, institutional, and stakeholder governance dimensions largely unobservable, systematically shaping theory selection, empirical strategy, and reported findings across the literature. Building on these considerations, the review makes three contributions. First, it provides a structural explanation for why agency theory dominates the field and argues that theoretical diversification requires investment in richer data rather than simply broader lens selection. Second, it demonstrates that standard governance variables function as bundled proxies whose effects are contingent on organizational form, regulatory status, and stakeholder structure, and proposes simultaneous equations modeling to capture the feedback loops between financial performance and social outreach that single-equation designs cannot estimate. Third, it identifies informal and relational governance mechanisms, trust-based networks, board members’ social capital, and stakeholder embeddedness as theoretically central but empirically absent, and proposes longitudinal and mixed-method designs to address this blind spot. Together, these contributions reframe the research agenda on MFI governance and call for a redefinition of effective governance in hybrid, mission-driven organizations.
abstract_zh: 小额信贷机构（MFIs）的公司治理显著影响其追求财务可持续性与社会外展的能力，然而二十年的实证研究却产生了零散且相互矛盾的发现。本文对2005年至2025年间发表的47篇同行评审研究进行了系统性回顾，考察治理机制如何塑造MFI的双重绩效。我们并未将理论集中性与实证不一致视为学术薄弱的迹象，而是证明这两者均反映了现有数据基础设施中嵌入的结构性约束。广泛使用的数据集，尤其是MIX Market，不成比例地支持代理理论构建，同时使关系性、制度性和利益相关者治理维度在很大程度上不可观测，从而系统性地影响了整个文献中的理论选择、实证策略和报告结果。基于这些考量，本综述做出三项贡献。首先，它为代理理论为何主导该领域提供了结构性解释，并主张理论多样化需要投资于更丰富的数据，而非仅仅选择更广泛的视角。其次，它证明标准治理变量作为捆绑代理变量发挥作用，其效应取决于组织形式、监管状态和利益相关者结构，并提出联立方程建模以捕捉财务绩效与社会外展之间的反馈循环，这是单一方程设计无法估计的。第三，它识别出非正式和关系性治理机制、基于信任的网络、董事会成员的社会资本以及利益相关者嵌入性在理论上至关重要但在实证中缺失，并提出纵向和混合方法设计以解决这一盲点。综合来看，这些贡献重新构建了MFI治理的研究议程，并呼吁重新定义混合型、使命驱动型组织中有效治理的内涵。

title: Using price incentives to bound welfare from pay as you go solar electricity
title_zh: 利用价格激励约束即付即用太阳能电力的福利
title_primary: 利用价格激励约束即付即用太阳能电力的福利
title_secondary: Using price incentives to bound welfare from pay as you go solar electricity
authors: Megan Lang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Quantifying the welfare effects of rural electrification is often hindered by non-price barriers that depress demand at the adoption margin. I study demand for pay-as-you-go (PAYGo) solar using a randomized experiment with 800 existing PAYGo customers in Kenya and Rwanda post-adoption. The experiment randomly assigns incentives that lower the effective price of usage for consumers who meet monthly purchase thresholds. Although average demand is unchanged, consumers with the highest pre-experimental demand increase their purchases by 6–7% in response to the incentive. I use these responses to estimate a lower bound on consumer surplus from PAYGo solar. I find large gains for high-demand consumers, but benefits deteriorate substantially for low-demand consumers. Combining my estimates with evidence from the literature on the environmental externalities of solar home systems, I calculate that the marginal value of public funds for PAYGo solar subsidies is at most 1.7 in Kenya and 2 in Rwanda.
abstract_zh: 量化农村电气化的福利效应，常常因非价格壁垒在采用边际上抑制需求而受阻。我通过一项随机实验，研究了肯尼亚和卢旺达800名现有按需付费（PAYGo）太阳能客户在采用后的需求情况。该实验随机分配激励措施，为达到月度购买门槛的消费者降低有效使用价格。尽管平均需求未变，但实验前需求最高的消费者对激励的反应是购买量增加6-7%。我利用这些反应估算了PAYGo太阳能消费者剩余的较低界限。我发现高需求消费者获得巨大收益，但低需求消费者的福利显著恶化。结合我的估计与文献中关于太阳能家庭系统环境外部性的证据，我计算出PAYGo太阳能补贴的公共资金边际价值在肯尼亚至多为1.7，在卢旺达至多为2。

title: Platform competition with common ownership and price parity clauses
title_zh: 共同所有权与价格平价条款下的平台竞争
title_primary: 共同所有权与价格平价条款下的平台竞争
title_secondary: Platform competition with common ownership and price parity clauses
authors: Zheng Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of common ownership on platform competition with price parity clauses (PPCs). We develop a model of two competing platforms and a multi-homing seller. While common ownership typically raises prices and reduces welfare without PPCs, it lowers platform fees and consumer prices under PPCs. As a result, it increases platform and seller profits, consumer surplus, and total welfare, generating a Pareto improvement.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了共同所有权在价格平价条款（PPCs）下对平台竞争的影响。我们构建了一个包含两个竞争平台和一个多归属卖家的模型。在没有PPCs的情况下，共同所有权通常会提高价格并降低福利；而在PPCs存在时，它则降低了平台费用和消费者价格。因此，共同所有权增加了平台和卖家的利润、消费者剩余及总福利，实现了帕累托改进。

title: Public support for military conservation: Understanding public opinion to the ‘war on poachers’ in three countries
title_zh: 公众对军事化保护的支持：理解三国公众对“反偷猎战争”的态度
title_primary: 公众对军事化保护的支持：理解三国公众对“反偷猎战争”的态度
title_secondary: Public support for military conservation: Understanding public opinion to the ‘war on poachers’ in three countries
authors: Lauren Yehle, Aksel Sundström, Patrik Michaelsen, Sverker C. Jagers
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The efforts made by states to curb wildlife poaching increasingly involve the deployment of military forces, especially in countries of the Global South. This shift towards a “war on poachers” can include measures such as shoot-on-sight policies, raising concerns about civil and human rights. While previous research has emphasized the perspectives of local communities, law enforcement, or hunters, to the best of our knowledge little is known about broader public support—an important factor for policy legitimacy and effectiveness. In this article, we examine public attitudes towards: (a) private and public protected areas managed by the military, (b) stronger criminal sanctions against poaching, and (c) granting expanded authority to the military to combat poaching. Using original national surveys from India, Indonesia, and South Africa—countries that have implemented aspects of militarized conservation—we found generally positive attitudes for military management of protected areas. In India and Indonesia, however, respondents still preferred non-military management when given a direct comparison. Across all three samples, people tended to support increasing military powers, particularly against commercial poaching. Respondents also favored maintaining or strengthening punishments for poachers. We conclude by identifying avenues for future research into the drivers of public support for militarized conservation.
abstract_zh: 各国为遏制野生动物偷猎所作的努力日益涉及部署军事力量，尤其是在全球南方国家。这种向“对偷猎者宣战”的转变可能包括“见即射杀”政策等措施，引发了对公民权利和人权的担忧。尽管以往研究侧重于当地社区、执法部门或猎人的视角，但据我们所知，关于更广泛公众支持——这一对政策合法性和有效性至关重要的因素——的了解仍然有限。在本文中，我们考察了公众对以下方面的态度：（a）由军方管理的私人和公共保护区，（b）对偷猎行为实施更严厉的刑事制裁，以及（c）授予军方更大权力以打击偷猎。利用来自印度、印度尼西亚和南非的原创全国性调查——这些国家已实施军事化保护的相关措施——我们发现，公众普遍对军方管理保护区持积极态度。然而，在印度和印度尼西亚，当直接比较时，受访者仍倾向于非军事管理。在所有三个样本中，人们倾向于支持扩大军方权力，尤其是针对商业偷猎。受访者还赞成维持或加强对偷猎者的惩罚。最后，我们指出了未来研究公众对军事化保护支持驱动因素的方向。

title: Robust Estimation and Inference in Panels with Interactive Fixed Effects
title_zh: 交互固定效应面板数据的稳健估计与推断
title_primary: 交互固定效应面板数据的稳健估计与推断
title_secondary: Robust Estimation and Inference in Panels with Interactive Fixed Effects
authors: Timothy B. Armstrong, Martin Weidner, Andrei Zeleneev
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider estimation and inference for a regression coefficient in panels with interactive fixed effects (i.e., with a factor structure). We demonstrate that existing estimators and confidence intervals (CIs) can be heavily biased and size-distorted when some of the factors are weak. We propose estimators with improved rates of convergence and bias-aware CIs that remain valid uniformly, regardless of factor strength. Our approach applies the theory of minimax linear estimation to form a debiased estimate, using a nuclear norm bound on the error of an initial estimate of the interactive fixed effects. Our resulting bias-aware CIs take into account the remaining bias caused by weak factors. Monte Carlo experiments show substantial improvements over conventional methods when factors are weak, with minimal costs to estimation accuracy when factors are strong.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了具有交互固定效应（即因子结构）的面板数据中回归系数的估计与推断问题。我们证明，当部分因子较弱时，现有估计量和置信区间可能存在严重偏误和尺寸扭曲。为此，我们提出具有更优收敛速度的估计量，以及无论因子强度如何均能保持均匀有效性的偏误感知置信区间。该方法运用极小化极大线性估计理论，通过对交互固定效应初始估计误差的核范数约束构建去偏估计量。由此得到的偏误感知置信区间能够充分考虑弱因子导致的剩余偏误。蒙特卡洛实验表明，在因子较弱时，该方法较传统方法有显著改进，而在因子较强时对估计精度的影响极小。

title: Science under Threat? A Natural Experiment in Economics
title_zh: 科学面临威胁？经济学中的一项自然实验
title_primary: 科学面临威胁？经济学中的一项自然实验
title_secondary: Science under Threat? A Natural Experiment in Economics
authors: Dominic Rohner, Oliver Vanden Eynde, Philine Widmer
official: 官方在线 2026-02-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Academic freedom has come under growing strain across the world. To study whether and how academics react to political pressure, we exploit a natural experiment: the U.S. government's "blacklist" of undesirable words released in early 2025. We find that the release of this list leads to a sharp reduction in the use of banned words in sensitive contexts among economists working at universities that rely heavily on NSF funding. The drop is particularly marked for content related to gender, race, and environment. Our findings are consistent with scholars responding strongly to political pressure through career incentives.
abstract_zh: 全球学术自由正面临日益加剧的压力。为探究学者是否及如何应对政治压力，我们利用一项自然实验：美国政府于2025年初发布的"敏感词汇黑名单"。研究发现，该名单发布后，在严重依赖美国国家科学基金会（NSF）资助的高校任职的经济学家中，敏感语境下禁用词汇的使用率显著下降。其中，涉及性别、种族及环境议题的词汇降幅尤为突出。研究结果表明，学者通过职业激励渠道对政治压力产生了强烈回应。

title: Government open data and corporate supply chain resilience: a quasi-natural experiment based on government data platform launch
title_zh: 政府数据开放与企业供应链韧性：基于政府数据平台开通的准自然实验
title_primary: 政府数据开放与企业供应链韧性：基于政府数据平台开通的准自然实验
title_secondary: Government open data and corporate supply chain resilience: a quasi-natural experiment based on government data platform launch
authors: Yufan Dai
official: 官方在线 2025-10-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates how the development of government open data platforms influences corporate supply chain resilience. Drawing on data between 2000 and 2022, it employs a staggered DID model to assess resilience changes. The results show that open data platforms significantly strengthen supply chain resilience by fostering corporate innovation and data assetization. Heterogeneity analysis further indicates stronger effects for firms with limited supply chain finance, those in cities with sound credit environments, and firms under high media scrutiny. Overall, the study offers theoretical and practical insights for improving data-related policies.

title: Preserving acquired rights in the re-placement of medical residents in Türkiye
title_zh: 土耳其住院医师重新安置中保留既得权利
title_primary: 土耳其住院医师重新安置中保留既得权利
title_secondary: Preserving acquired rights in the re-placement of medical residents in Türkiye
authors: Orhan Aygün, Günnur Ege Bilgin
official: 官方在线 2025-08-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze the re-placement mechanism implemented in Türkiye for reassigning doctors to residency programs after scoring errors were realized. By law, initial placements based on faulty scores are acquired rights, prohibiting re-placement to less favorable programs. This setup requires balancing fairness for doctors with improved rankings, preserving acquired rights, and adhering to program capacities. Our analysis focuses on the two-step serial dictatorship mechanism implemented by the Center for Assessment, Selection, and Placement (CASP) to address this problem. We show that the CASP mechanism violates fairness, such that higher-scoring doctors may justifiably envy the assignments of lower-scoring peers. Yet, when doctors adopt a weakly dominant strategy and truncate preferences below their initial placements, a more lenient notion of q-fairness is satisfied. Additionally, we show how manipulation incentives under the CASP mechanism lead to excessive deviations from target capacities. We propose the Acquired Rights Adjusted Serial Dictatorship (AR-SD) mechanism to prevent strategic manipulation and minimize deviations. Furthermore, we describe simple modifications to the CASP mechanism that render it equivalent to AR-SD. Finally, simulations using total deviations as a metric show that AR-SD consistently achieves fewer deviations than the CASP mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了土耳其在发现评分错误后，为重新分配医生至住院医师项目而实施的重新安置机制。根据法律，基于错误评分的初次安置被视为既得权利，禁止将医生重新安置至较不理想的方案。这一设定要求在改善排名的医生公平性、维护既得权利以及遵守项目容量之间寻求平衡。我们的分析聚焦于评估、选拔与安置中心（CASP）为解决此问题而实施的两步序列独裁机制。我们证明，CASP机制违反了公平性，使得得分较高的医生可能合理地对得分较低同行的分配产生嫉妒。然而，当医生采取弱主导策略并将其偏好截断至初次安置之下时，一种更为宽松的q-公平性概念得以满足。此外，我们展示了CASP机制下的操纵激励如何导致对目标容量的过度偏离。我们提出了既得权利调整序列独裁（AR-SD）机制，以防止策略性操纵并最小化偏离。进一步，我们描述了将CASP机制简单修改后使其等同于AR-SD的方法。最后，使用总偏离度作为指标的模拟显示，AR-SD始终比CASP机制实现更少的偏离。
